label: Counting crossing clique edges
subgoals: Count the pins of the net on each side
Multiply the two counts to get crossing clique edges
Compare with the hyperedge cut of 1

label: Weighting to reduce the distortion
subgoals: Compute the crossing weight m(k - m)/(k - 1)
Note that no single weight makes every split cost 1

label: Graph cut versus hypergraph cut
subgoals: Sum m(k - m)/(k - 1) over nets to get the graph cut
Check that the graph cut is at least the number of cut nets
Keep nets as hyperedges when the objective counts cut nets
